purpose: Explain in prose why a buyer would pick Reevo over this one competitor: an intro paragraph, three (or four) short reason pairs of a title and an explanation, and for two competitors a colour-accented callout that frames the competitor as a product of an earlier era.

behaviour.note: Two visual variants driven by data, not by a prop the author chooses: HubSpot and Salesforce carry an accent colour and a callout; the other five (apollo, attio, fireflies, gong, outreach) are plain. The accent colour tints only the reason titles and the callout box background; everything else is unchanged.

The accent is that competitor's own brand colour (a hex value per competitor); it is a per-competitor data value, not a design token. Callout text is white on the accent, so the accent must stay dark enough for white text.
Reason count is 3 for six competitors and 4 for gong (a fourth reason appears there only).

Callout: square image in the left columns beside a coloured text box. The image is a competitor logo card (an existing PNG per competitor, real third-party mark); it is hidden below md so on phones only the coloured text box shows. The text box overlaps the image by 16px from md.
Sits on the white background with the pattern-02 decorative strip, after the quick-table. The eyebrow label is fixed text; the headline is one bold sentence per competitor.

Data quirks carried over from the original and worth knowing: the Fireflies headline names the wrong competitor, and the HubSpot and Salesforce intro paragraph mentions a third competitor. These are copy defects in the source data, not contract rules; do not replicate them for a new competitor.
All text is competitor-comparison copy written by the original author; it is deliberately not reproduced here. Author new competitors with the budgets below and factual, verifiable statements only.

themeDependency.how: Default light scope (bg-background). The callout box uses a fixed white text colour on an arbitrary accent background, so it would not survive being placed inside a dark scope unless the accent were re-checked.

variants.name: plain
variants.description: No accent, no callout: intro paragraph and reasons only. Used for apollo, attio, fireflies, gong and outreach.

variants.name: accent-with-callout
variants.description: accent hex present: reason titles take the accent colour, and a callout row (logo card image plus white text on an accent-coloured box) closes the section. Used for hubspot and salesforce only.

headline.note: Bold h2 question naming the competitor. Observed up to 7 words.

intro.note: Intro paragraphs under the headline; every competitor has exactly 1.

items.note: Observed up to 55 words; text plus optional bold segments.

reasons.note: 3 reasons for six competitors, 4 for gong. Each is a title in the left columns and a body in the right columns.

title.note: Large bold title. Observed up to 7 words.

body.note: Explanation, plain text. Observed up to 42 words.

accent.note: Hex colour for reason titles and the callout background. Present only when a callout is present (hubspot, salesforce).

callout.note: Present only on hubspot and salesforce, and only together with accent.

image.note: Square lazy-loaded image (object-cover) of the competitor's logo card; existing real file only.

text.note: White text on the accent box. Observed about 103 words in both callouts.

motion.reducedMotionNote: No animation; the code has no prefers-reduced-motion handling.
